title: Status in ServiceNow is not the same as in EPO (lifecycle review)
cardHint: A manager found that the status of a sampled CI is not the same as in EPO. SACM looks at the source first.
cardText: From the lifecycle review (Audit, Lifecycle): a manager compared the status of a sampled CI with EPO and marked it Not the same. A service mapped CI: SACM copies the status of EPO into ServiceNow. A CI that is not service mapped should follow EPO by itself: raise an incident with the ServiceNow development team. Only when EPO itself looks wrong, press "EPO itself looks wrong: ask the owner" on the line. A line stays to solve until a later report shows another status for the CI.

message.subject: Status differs from EPO
message.intro: In our lifecycle review, their status in ServiceNow was not the same as in EPO, and the status in EPO looks wrong to us.
message.ask: Which status is right? Please correct it in EPO, or {reply}.
message.why: The status decides whether a CI is followed up, and whether incidents and changes can use it.

playbook.askWhenUnsure: EPO itself looks wrong: ask the owner
